title: Refinery Operations Intelligence
thesis: Snowflake ingests 2M sensor readings per day from 24 process units — ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION catches process excursions before safety shutdowns, Dynamic Tables compute unit availability, and Cortex Agent answers operational questions in natural language

talking_points: Twenty-four process units monitored in real-time — CDU, VDU, FCC, reformers, hydrotreaters.
Forty-two alarms in the last 48 hours — 6 rated HIGH severity.
Overall unit availability at 98.2% — but Unit 7 reformer dropped to 91%.

transition.line: Let's drill into what's causing the alarm spike.

talking_points: ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION running on all 24 units — catches process excursions before safety systems trip.
Unit 7 reformer: reactor inlet temperature drifting 8°C above normal — confirmed anomalous.
Three excursions in 48 hours — correlates with catalyst deactivation pattern.
show: Click Unit 7 in the process unit list
Show temperature trend with anomaly markers
tabs.call_out: 3 excursions in 48hrs — catalyst deactivation signature detected

transition.line: The excursion is confirmed. Let's check the economics.

talking_points: RM 1.8 billion monthly throughput value at risk if availability drops.
ML.FORECAST projects Unit 7 throughput declining 12% over next 7 days if uncorrected.
Dynamic Tables compute real-time crack spread by process unit.
show: Point at RM 1.8B monthly value KPI
tabs.call_out: RM 1.8B/month throughput — 12% decline forecast for Unit 7

transition.line: What do the operations manuals say about this pattern?

talking_points: Encik Razali asks: 'Which units triggered alarms in the last 48 hours?'
Cortex Analyst returns: 5 units, 42 alarms, Unit 7 leading with 14.
Switch to advisor: 'What does the SOP say about reformer temperature excursion?' — searches 80 docs instantly.
show: Type: 'Which units have alarms in last 48 hours?'

transition.line: Every capability — native Snowflake, streaming IoT ingestion.

talking_points: Seven Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
IoT Core streams 2M readings/day to Snowpipe Streaming — sub-second latency.
Malaysia refines 500,000+ bbl/d. This monitors 24 units at Pengerang.
tabs.call_out: One platform, real-time IoT, native anomaly detection

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for refinery operations.
